title: Access of resource using incompatible type ('type confusion') in Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) allows an…
description: A type confusion vulnerability in Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code remotely. The flaw involves accessing a resource using an incompatible type, which can lead to remote code execution over a network. The vulnerability has a high severity score of 8.8 and requires user interaction to exploit.
